name: coffee-shell
description: ROAST/TTY: a demo coffee-bean shop TUI served over SSH. Not a real shop.

scripts.test: cargo build -p coffee-tui && cargo test --workspace && vitest run
scripts.test:tui: cd apps/tui && nsh test && nsh test --target tui
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build -p coffee-tui && cargo test -p tty-gateway --tests
scripts.test:e2e:real: cargo build -p coffee-tui -p tty-gateway && python3 scripts/e2e/run.py
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm check:mocks && pnpm typecheck && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm check:tui && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:tui
